kicker: LEDGER · Wednesday 28 October, evening · one decision
title: Your camera pulled back: what it costs
how: Shortfalls first. Tom still wears placeholder white shorts and bare feet, and the jacket has its known faults; the street keeps its own small faults (puddles, a pavement joint, the kiosk's see-through side). The other people are hidden: their clothes are placeholders.

Your answer: back to the Between picture's height, his head level with the far end of the street, the feet in by pulling back. Measured in the packaged game: at that height his feet come fully in only from 3.0 m, because in a stride his near heel is about 30 cm behind him (at 2.6 to 2.9 m a heel is still off the frame). At 3.1 m Tom is about 77% of his Between size and his head sits below the far end. Tilting the camera down does not help: on this arm it swings up as it tilts, so at 2.4 m the heels stay cut even at 22 degrees and the street's far end leaves the frame (tried). So it is size or feet. Pick one; the first is recommended.
foot: Nothing bought or signed up for. The game's camera sits at 3.1 m until you pick. Running, rooms, talk and fights get their own framing after this, each shown to you first.
